svg.text: 36 mm across the skirt, 40 mm crown, 46 mm tall; timer boss to 52 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside the 17 mm skirt: 28 mm PCO 1881 female thread, 2.7 mm pitch

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deck 4 mm thick with a 17 mm water bore; well bore 20.4 mm above it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top 7.5 mm: 22.4 mm female thread, 2 mm pitch, for the plug

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side slot 7.5 x 28 x 22.5 mm with a 2.2 mm bearing hole for the timer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 1.6 mm pilot holes for the window screws, 31.5 mm apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print skirt-down, 0.15 mm layers, 100 % infill; ream the well bore to 20.4 +/-0.05
